note: Exact425 plus explicit actual principal-coordinate normalization and represented affine slices. A genuine test point with invertible selected coordinate is equivalent to a test-ring unit times a point of the original symmetric parameter algebra modulo coordinate-minus-one. Actual coordinate division and its inverse are proved, arbitrary coefficient rings and nilpotents retained, and unit stabilizers on each chart are trivial. The original finite projective module is not replaced by a free module. This supplies local relative-unit quotient charts; global slice overlap/gluing and represented Picard remain open.
